overview: You looked at the slip after the telling. It had five condemned, and the charge of high treason, levying war, not riot. It had no day. You did not supply a title, and you did not carry the slip home.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the charge and left the paper where it was.

assets.disposition: Read the charge of levying war
